scope: Read-only aggregate of all current disconnected physical-pad groups after IMU promotion, with detailed MCU/core/USB supply-return context. No route, search, refill, placement, rule, CAD or optimization operation.

method.graph: One CopperGraph construction over all enabled copper and exact filled islands.
method.pad_functions: Native PCB pad GetPinFunction/GetPinType and actual net names; no RP2040 pad-number assumptions.

local_zone_and_protected_corridor_contex.interpretation: Rule-area records are actual native definitions and enabled layers. Bounds are context only, not route-clearance or path qualification.

policy: USB differential, clock/crystal, switching/high-current and private-pickoff geometry remains Astra-reserved.
Do not infer continuous return beneath clock/USB exclusions from net connectivity.
All IMU, filled/capped process vias, contact interfaces and accepted CAD bindings remain frozen.

proposed_next_bounded_scope.name: One VCORE group-to-group closure
constraints: Root/Astra must choose layer, width, via use and exact path; this is not route authorization.
Preserve clock/USB rule areas, protected In1 GND, existing decoupler copper and all IMU/process geometry.
Review the return path and RP2040 VCORE decoupling topology before copper generation.
No relocation, grid search, rule reduction or plane change is released.
missing_engineering_decisions: Whether this nearest group pair is the preferred first VCORE topology edge.
Allowed copper layer and via topology around the MCU/clock exclusions.
Required width/current/transient target and return adjacency.

limitations: Connected-group inventory counts root defects, not repeated DRC pair witnesses.
Terminal coordinates and straight-line distances do not select or approve a route.
No powered, SI/PI, thermal, physical-stackup, supplier-process or fabrication conclusion.

compaction.operation: Removed duplicated copper UUID lists and repeated full net objects only; all disconnected groups, pads, functions, positions, bounds, layers, vias, focus terminal endpoints and proposal evidence remain.
